pr_title: feat: make console/dialog events based on subscription
pr_body:
This way we do not send events from the server unless the client is interested.

Fixes #22621.

issue_context.title: [BUG] JavaScript heap out of memory with a lot of ConsoleMessages
issue_context.body:
## System info
- Playwright Version: [v1.32.1]
- Operating System: [MacOS]
- Browser: [Chromium]

## Source code
```
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright


async def test():
    try:
        playwright = await async_playwright().start()
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(
            headless=False
        )
        context = await browser.new_context(
            locale='en-US',
            java_script_enabled=True
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto('https://zred-clothing.com/', timeout=30000)
        except Exception as e:
            print(e)
        await asyncio.sleep(10)
        title = await page.title()
        print(title)
        await page.close()
        await page.context.close()
        playwright.stop()
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)

asyncio.run(test())
```

comments:
The issue is that in 10 seconds this website logs around 55k console messages which has a ~50 character memory footprint each.

Assigning it to this release to have lazy event listeners for console messages like we have for request/response etc.
Note to myself: works fine after this patch, CPU usage stays at 70% and memory does not grow.
